name: merchOne for WooCommerce
author: merchOne

sections.description:
Print On Demand Fulfillment for Experienced Ecommerce Sellers.
At merchOne, print-on-demand is at the core of what we do. We provide home decor fulfillment designed to meet the needs of established and scaling ecommerce sellers. With in-house production sites in both the EU and US, we ensure consistency and control at every step. merchOne integration with WooCommerce supports efficient product management. Start drop-shipping with flexible orders, fair pricing, and support. Especially suited for personalized wall art and pet-themed prints.

Print-on-Demand Fulfillment: Sell with no inventory or order minimums.
Home Decor Range: Various formats and sizes for all customer styles.
Sustainable Pricing: Affordable without compromising on quality.
Reliable Operations: Proven logistics now powering your storefront.
Consistent Fulfillment: On-time shipping with late daily cut-offs.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin
  2. Upload the plugin to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Click merchOne in left menu follow the instructions to connect your WooCommerce store with merchOne
sections.faq:
What is merchOne?

merchOne is a print-on-demand fulfillment service that specializes in home decor and pet-themed prints. We handle production and shipping directly to your customers.

Do I need a merchOne account?

Yes, you need to create a merchOne account at https://merchone.com to connect your WooCommerce store.

What products can I sell?

merchOne offers a wide range of home decor products including wall art, canvas prints, and various formats suitable for personalized designs.

Is there a minimum order requirement?

No, merchOne operates on a print-on-demand model with no minimum order requirements.
